# Contact sensor

Query target: `CONTACT_SENSOR`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

|---|---|---|
| [contactEventAnchorCount](#contacteventanchorcount) | read | the event's contact points / friction anchors |
| [contactEventAnchorImpulse](#contacteventanchorimpulse) | read | impulse, as reported (world) |
| [contactEventAnchorPosition](#contacteventanchorposition) | read | position (world) |
| [contactEventCollider](#contacteventcollider) | read | the sensor's own collider prim |
| [contactEventOtherBody](#contacteventotherbody) | read | the other body's prim |
| [contactEventOtherCollider](#contacteventothercollider) | read | the other collider's prim |
| [contactEventOtherProtoIndex](#contacteventotherprotoindex) | read | the collider's instance index in its point instancer — its slot in `protoIndices`, not the prototype it selects — own / other (0xFFFFFFFF: not an instance) |
| [contactEventPointCount](#contacteventpointcount) | read | the event's contact points / friction anchors |
| [contactEventPointFaceIndex](#contacteventpointfaceindex) | read | triangle-mesh face index, own / other |
| [contactEventPointImpulse](#contacteventpointimpulse) | read | impulse, as reported (world) |

| [contactEventPointSeparation](#contacteventpointseparation) | read | separation |
| [contactEventProtoIndex](#contacteventprotoindex) | read | the collider's instance index in its point instancer — its slot in `protoIndices`, not the prototype it selects — own / other (0xFFFFFFFF: not an instance) |

## netFrictionContactForce

`f32`; units: [mass * distance / sec^2](units.md#force); frame: world; semantic: vector.

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Read | fixed, shape [objects], 3 lanes | scene device |

**Read:** requires [DirectGPU warmup](#directgpu-warmup).

Separate child-collider rows exist only on CPU or GPU with CPU readback. DirectGPU omits them; standalone static collider rows remain but read zero force. Opposing friction-anchor forces cancel in the net vector, so it does not represent friction torque.

## Conditions

### Contact events

CPU/readback contact event data only; DirectGPU events are unsupported. Per-event counts partition point and anchor arrays.

### Contact filters

Requires a contact query with filters; element ordering and companion counts identify each filter partition.

### DirectGPU warmup

Device-backed DirectGPU state requires a completed first step; a write never warms the simulation automatically.
